papers.title: Densification and microstructural investigation of Inconel 718 parts fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Powder & Ceramic Division, Korea Institute of Materials Science (KIMS), Changwon 51508, Republic of Korea

corresponding_authors.name: Ji‐Hun Yu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Powder & Ceramic Division, Korea Institute of Materials Science (KIMS), Changwon 51508, Republic of Korea

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Inconel 718高温合金的选区激光熔化致密化与微观组织，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aerospace superalloy Inconel 718 without any biomedical context, porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, or osseointegration considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺参数制备高致密度Inconel 718零件
summary_zh.method: 系统改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数并分析致密化行为
summary_zh.result: 获得接近全致密的Inconel 718试样
summary_zh.validation: 采用密度测量和显微组织观察验证

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting parameters for producing fully dense Inconel 718 components.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of laser power, scan speed, and other parameters with analysis of densification behavior.
summary_en.result: Near-full density Inconel 718 specimens were achieved with optimized parameters.
summary_en.validation: Density measurements and microstructural observations were used to validate the results.

papers.title: Biofabrication of size controllable silver nanoparticles – A green approach
papers.first_author_affiliation: The Key laboratory of Advanced Textile Materials and Manufacturing Technology of Ministry of Education, National Engineering Lab for Textile Fiber Materials and Processing Technology (Zhejiang), College of Materials and Textiles, Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, Hangzhou 310018, China; Trace Elements Speciation Research Laboratory, Department of Chemistry, School of Advanced Sciences, VIT University, Vellore 632014, India

corresponding_authors.name: Badal Kumar Mandal
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Trace Elements Speciation Research Laboratory, Department of Chemistry, School of Advanced Sciences, VIT University, Vellore 632014, India. Electronic address: badalkmandal@hotmail.com

papers.venue: Journal of Photochemistry and Photobiology B Biology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文与基于AI的生物打印研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve AI, bioprinting, or any workflow stage integration; it focuses on chemical synthesis of nanoparticles.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索绿色方法合成可控尺寸的银纳米粒子。
summary_zh.method: 采用生物基还原剂和稳定剂制备纳米银。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出尺寸可控的银纳米粒子。
summary_zh.validation: 通过紫外-可见光谱和透射电镜表征。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an environmentally friendly method for synthesizing silver nanoparticles with controlled size.
summary_en.method: Green synthesis using biological reducing and stabilizing agents.
summary_en.result: Size-controllable silver nanoparticles were successfully produced.
summary_en.validation: Characterization via UV-Vis spectroscopy and transmission electron microscopy.

papers.title: Effects of heat treatments on microstructure and properties of Ti-6Al-4V ELI alloy fabricated by electron beam melting (EBM)
papers.first_author_affiliation: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Integrative Materials Design Center, 100 Institute Road, Worcester, MA 01609, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Robert J. Warren
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Integrative Materials Design Center, 100 Institute Road, Worcester, MA 01609, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究电子束熔化Ti-6Al-4V ELI合金的热处理效应，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous implant design, stress shielding, LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on heat treatment effects on EBM Ti-6Al-4V ELI alloy properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对电子束熔化Ti-6Al-4V ELI合金显微组织与性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对EBM制备的试样进行不同热处理，测试显微组织与力学性能
summary_zh.result: 合理的热处理可优化显微组织并提升力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织观察与力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the influence of heat treatments on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V ELI alloy fabricated by electron beam melting.
summary_en.method: Apply various heat treatment protocols to EBM-fabricated specimens and characterize microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Specific heat treatments refine the microstructure and enhance mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation through microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
